summary: IDS feed c001_broker is severely degraded: 48.02% packet loss due to egress oversubscription on VF-1 port 5. 1 Gbps IDS port is saturated (100% avg load, bursts higher) and discarded 17,324,940 packets.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker egress oversubscription/congestion on VF-1 port 5 to IDS. Average load is 100% of 1 Gbps with bursts higher, exceeding the 1 Gbps tool port capacity, causing tail drops in the broker egress queue (17,324,940 discards, 48.02% loss).
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS misses ~48% of packets/flows. Stateful TCP reassembly, signature matching and anomaly detection fail on dropped traffic; IDS is blind to nearly half of attacks and cannot maintain flow state, drastically reducing detection coverage despite needing full payload and both directions.

params.suggestion: upgrade tool connectivity to 10 Gbps or create load-balancing/LAG group across 2+ IDS instances/ports

recommended_fix.why: Distributing offered traffic that exceeds 1 Gbps across multiple tool ports or upgrading to 10 Gbps eliminates egress queue drops and restores complete, correct traffic delivery without filtering payload the IDS requires for detection.
